fields.description: Master switch for the verified signup flow. When off, the signup API returns a disabled message and creates nothing.
fields.label: Signup Enabled

fields.description: Require email OTP verification. Turning this off disables signup entirely.
fields.label: Email OTP Enabled

fields.description: Require phone OTP verification. Needs a configured gateway in SMS Settings, or Dev Mode. Turning this off disables signup entirely.
fields.label: Phone OTP Enabled

fields.description: Write email OTP codes to the site log instead of emailing them. Codes must still be entered. NEVER enable in production.
fields.label: Email OTP Dev Mode

fields.description: Write phone OTP codes to the site log instead of sending them by SMS. Codes must still be entered. NEVER enable in production.
fields.label: Phone OTP Dev Mode

fields.description: How long a code stays valid, in seconds.
fields.label: OTP Validity (seconds)

fields.description: Wrong guesses allowed per issued code before it is destroyed.
fields.label: Max Verify Attempts

fields.description: Total codes that may be sent per channel, per signup session.
fields.label: Max Sends Per Channel

fields.description: How many signups one IP address may begin per hour. Keep generous: mobile carriers in Egypt put many customers behind a single public IP, so a tight limit blocks real people, not just abuse. Per-session OTP caps are the tighter control.
fields.label: Signup Starts Per Hour Per IP

fields.description: Dotted path to a custom SMS sender, called as sender(phone_e164, message). Leave blank to use Frappe's SMS Settings gateway.
fields.label: SMS Sender Method

fields.description: How long an in-progress signup stays alive, refreshed on every successful step.
fields.label: Session Validity (minutes)

fields.description: Days to keep expired and cancelled sessions before the daily purge removes them.
fields.label: Session Retention (days)

fields.description: How many parts of a name a customer record must carry: first name, father's name and family name. A business requirement about this shop's own records, not a rule about how names work - some naming systems are complete in fewer parts, and a customer using one is told plainly what is needed rather than that their name is wrong. Counted on the name as typed, ignoring tokens with no letters in them.
fields.label: Required Name Components

fields.description: ISO region used to interpret phone numbers typed without a country code.
fields.label: Default Phone Region

fields.description: Customer Group for Customers created by signup. Must be a leaf group, not a group node.
fields.label: Default Customer Group

fields.description: Territory for Customers created by signup. Must be a leaf territory, not a group node.
fields.label: Default Territory
